package.name: crowd_nav_zones
package.description: Dynamic keep-out zones (Phase 3): AddZone/RemoveZone services backing a live-regenerated costmap filter mask, wired into Nav2's stock costmap_filter_info_server + a dedicated map_server instance + KeepoutFilter in the local costmap. No custom collision-checking logic - the mask is the only new thing here, everything that turns it into an enforced no-go region is stock Nav2.
